svg.title: Server and client event boundaries with separate clock domains
svg.desc: Constructed server clock S records arrival one hundred admission one hundred ten execution one hundred thirty prefill completion one hundred sixty five selection one hundred seventy stable text one hundred eighty five write one hundred ninety and terminal two hundred thirty microseconds. Separate client clock C records start one thousand payload eleven ninety terminal twelve fifty. Only compatible same domain intervals are subtracted; lanes do not share a time axis.
svg.text: Name the boundary and the clock before computing a duration
First selection 170 → stable text 185 → local write accepted 190
Client domain C: a separate origin and observation path
Payload latency = 190 μs; completion latency = 250 μs.
Client 1190 − server 185 is not a network delay measurement
No common axis or cross-clock mapping is supplied for these lanes.
